Name: Oranges 'N Cream ReShade Preset
Author: lilianap
Description:
[font=Courier New][center][i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/63xHQ3w3/icon.png[/img]﻿

Oranges 'N Cream is a shader preset [/i][i]created for Stardew Valley with [font=Courier New][url=https://reshade.me/]ReShade[/url]﻿ 5.4.2[/font][/i][/center][/font]
[b][left][font=Courier New][i][font=Courier New]
[/font][/i][/font][img]https://i.postimg.cc/k4WpNSw-K/2.gif[/img]﻿[font=Courier New]
[u]
[/u][/font][font=Courier New][i] ﻿// How to install ReShade [/i]
[/font][font=Courier New]
[/font][/left][/b][list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]- Go to the [url=https://reshade.me/]ReShade[/url]﻿ website and click the download button.[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Run the file it gives you and click browse. Go to your Stardew valley folder (The one with Stardew Valley.exe in it)[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Choose EITHER Stardew Valley.exe if you want to play vanilla OR StardewModdingAPI.exe if you want to use ReShade with mods.[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Choose OpenGL. If you chose the wrong one, restart from step 2.[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Finish the installation as usual.[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Run Stardew Valley as usual. Make sure you run the .exe you installed ReShade onto, be it the vanilla game or the ModdingAPI. [/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- You should see a grey bar up at the top. Press the Home button to do the tutorial, and you're set! You've successfully installed ReShade.[/font]
[/list][i]
﻿[/i][font=Courier New][i]// How to install Oranges 'N Cream[/i]

[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]- Open up your Stardew folder. (The one where you installed ReShade) [/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Copy 'oranges.n.cream.ini' and 'reshade-shaders'[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]- Paste the two files into your Stardew folder. (if it asks if you want to merge, say yes. [b]don't replace![/b])[/font]

[*][font=Courier New]- Done! You should be able to access the preset in Stardew Valley now.[/font]
[/list][center]
﻿
